trimmed_dict.title: Ohio University Fringe Festival
trimmed_dict.description:
The Ohio University Fringe Festival is an event that welcomes all creatives. We value and prioritize the production of new works, innovative risk-taking, and cross-discipline collaboration. Our aim is for this festival to not be an end point but a launching pad, an incubator of new ideas and a place for students and community members to explore their own unique artistic voices that can extend and grow beyond the bounds of the OU campus to be shared with the rest of the world. 

 

Fringe Festival Events will be taking place throughout the afternoon and evenings of Wednesday April 22 through Saturday April 25.

View  full schedule of events here.
